title: A spectral map is constructibly continuous, has quasi-compact fibres and constructibly closed image
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows three properties of a spectral map of spectral spaces: it is continuous for the constructible topology, its fibres are quasi-compact and its image is constructibly closed (author lemma at source lines 4588-4596, label lemma-fibres-spectral-map-quasi-compact). The proof (source lines 4598-4618) works with the constructible topologies, where the source and target are quasi-compact Hausdorff, and transfers quasi-compactness along the map from the constructible fibres to the fibres in the given topology (proof lines 4598-4616). The fibre comparison is the substance. H3.
